name: How do older homes in the Denver metro area affect cabinet installation?

mainEntity.name: How do older homes in the Denver metro area affect cabinet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: In older neighborhoods across Denver, Centennial, and Greenwood Village, homes often feature settling foundations, uneven subfloors, and walls that are not plumb or square. Professional installers account for these variations by using laser levels, custom scribing, and strategic shimming to ensure every cabinet hangs true without visible gaps. Additionally, Colorado's dry climate can cause natural wood to contract, making proper indoor acclimation of solid wood cabinet doors critical prior to hanging.
acceptedAnswer.description: Settling foundations and uneven walls require custom shimming, scribing, and laser leveling to align cabinets, while local dry air requires proper wood acclimation.
